_about: WARHAWK 707 (Grand Cherokee Trackhawk): its cluster's needles were cut out of the model with its steering wheel (they swung round with it as it turned): moved back into the body (body_parts). Its centre screen is the radio page painted into its own texture (jeep2018gps, 221 x 153 px, stored mirrored: flip_h; its UVs a tile over: uv_wrap): kept as painted, its clock made live. The cluster's own picture is mapped too unevenly to draw on. Box: m from the steering wheel's centre (x right, y up, z back); screen pixels: the picture as it's seen.
